==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
An elderly government official stands to give an announcement. They are at a podium in front of a crowd. No one is sure of what he might say.

The government official is revealed to be already dead. This is there ghost. They can't leave Earth until they share one final message.

There is a great energy that exists beyond the Earth. Some might call it God or magic. Others might refer to it as living, alien, energy.
